action.objective: Commit verified Kh6 as the only commit-ready move; keep king active while staying near the h-file checks.
action.rationale: Only commit_ready move. Kh6 passed safety probes (no mate in one, no checking chain to mate in three). Kg7 is the other strong candidate at depth 4 (-600 exact) but is unverified for safety. Kh6 attacks g5-g7/h5/h7, keeping king flexible; K+R vs K is drawish, so a safe king move suffices.
